requirement_text.REQ-067: Port src/api/pagination.zig as Letflow.Api.Pagination. Six acceptance criteria: constants (MAX_PAGE_SIZE 200, DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE 50, MIN_PAGE_SIZE 1, expiry 86_400_000_000us), page-size reject-not-clamp on 0/201/non-numeric, cross-endpoint prefix rejection, expiry rejection, INV-1 tenant isolation (Cursor struct has no tenant field, plus a cross-tenant replay test), and pagination completeness across 3+ pages.

Same counts TEST-RUNNER got, but per core-directives.md this is not treated as confirming evidence by itself -- I re-derived attribution from scratch. (2) Confirmed `git diff --name-only main...HEAD` (24 files) does not contain test/support/tenant_schema_reaper_test.exs or test/support/tenant_schema_reaper.ex -- Route 1 holds independently. (3) Grepped partition-1.log myself for the 3 failures: each failure (lines 427/490/546) is immediately preceded by TenantSchemaReaper.sweep_orphans/2's own 'deferring this sweep entirely -- another mix test invocation ... is currently connected' log line (ISS-0110 guard), confirmed by direct grep of the log file, not by trusting the report's quoted excerpt. (4) Ran the causal check myself: `mix test test/support/tenant_schema_reaper_test.exs` alone (no sibling mix test process) -> Result: 6 passed, 0 failed -- same 3 tests pass cleanly in isolation, isolating the variable to a concurrent sibling mix test connection, exactly as the guard's own log states. Route 1 + Route 3 both independently confirmed; attribution PRE-EXISTING/ENVIRONMENTAL, not caused by this branch, consistent with (but not copied from) TEST-RUNNER's report and the already-filed ISS-0217/GH#441. (5) Confirmed all six REQ-067 acceptance criteria directly against lib/letflow/api/pagination.ex and test/letflow/api/pagination_test.exs: AC1 constants (pagination.ex:38-41 @max_page_size 200/@default_page_size 50/@min_page_size 1/@cursor_expiry_us 86_400_000_000, accessors at :79-93, asserted via accessor not literal at pagination_test.exs:18-32); AC2 reject-not-clamp (validate_page_size/1 at :135-144 has no clamping branch -- 0 and >200 both return {:error, :page_size_too_large}, 1 and 200 pass through unchanged; parse_page_size_param/1 at :113-121 rejects non-numeric/decimal/negative/trailing-garbage via `Integer.parse/1` full-string match; tests at pagination_test.exs:37-85 pin all four fence-posts 0/1/200/201 plus non-numeric cases); AC3 cross-endpoint prefix rejection (check_prefix/2 at :211-218, decode_cursor/4 step 2 at :196; test at pagination_test.exs:89-108 mints with prefix 'T:', decodes with 'I:', asserts {:error, :wrong_endpoint}, plus a same-prefix positive control); AC4 expiry rejection (check_expiry/2 at :248-257 compares System.system_time(:microsecond) against the embedded timestamp; test at pagination_test.exs:113-138 uses a fixed old timestamp (0) with no wall-clock wait, plus a custom-narrower-window case proving the 4th arg is read); AC5 INV-1 tenant isolation (Cursor defstruct is exactly `[:inner]` at pagination.ex:54, asserted structurally at pagination_test.exs:144-148 via Map.from_struct/1 |> Map.keys(); cross-tenant replay test at pagination_test.exs:174-199 mints a cursor from tenant A's row id, decodes it, replays it scoped to tenant B via a test-fixture store, and asserts only tenant B's rows return, with a non-vacuous tenant-A control); AC6 pagination completeness (test at pagination_test.exs:248-265 pages 25 fixture rows at page_size=10 across exactly 3 pages (10/10/5), asserts total==25, no duplicate ids, sorted ids match original set exactly, and next_cursor is nil only on the final page). All six confirmed against the actual shipped code and test file, not against the design doc, TEST-RUNNER's report, or TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's summary. (6) Checked docs/status/requirement_status.v2.yaml (REQ-067's only entry, line 353, is `event: started`, consistent with in_progress) and docs/requirements.yaml (REQ-067 entry at line 3779-3784 has `status: in_progress`) -- both match what has actually shipped so far (implementation done, gates passed, not yet flipped to done); no staleness found. Both are correctly awaiting Step 6/DOC-UPDATER's flip to `done`, which this PASS on REQ-067's own criteria authorizes. Overall verdict PARTIAL, mirroring TEST-RUNNER's own verdict for the same reason: REQ-067's own module and all six of its acceptance criteria are fully verified and clean, but 3 full-suite failures exist and were independently reproduced by this agent; they are structurally attributed to an unrelated, already-filed, pre-existing environmental interaction (ISS-0217/GH#441), not to this branch, so they do not block REQ-067 from proceeding to done.
